description: Customers are unable to log in, with password entry rejected and login blocked by ads.
name: Cannot log into account

description: Customers feel basic features like choosing specific songs and skipping are now restricted to premium subscribers.
name: Features locked behind premium

description: Customers find lyrics appear for some songs but not others, or fail to display at all.
name: Lyrics missing or inconsistent

description: Customers report that many songs and certain genres such as gospel music are not available.
name: Songs and genres missing

description: Customers do not want recommended content inserted into their own playlists and feel recommendations have degraded.
name: Unwanted recommendations interrupting playlists

description: Customers find song downloads stall in the background until the app is reopened.
name: Downloads get stuck

description: Customers report that offline mode does not function as expected.
name: Offline mode not working

description: Customers broadly criticize the app as worst or useless, especially after a recent update, without naming a specific problem.
name: General dissatisfaction with app

description: Customers find music audio adjustment settings do not work properly.
name: Audio adjustment settings not working

description: Customers cannot connect over Wi-Fi although mobile data works.
name: Wi-Fi connection failures

description: Customers report the app crashes after updates or gets stuck on the loading screen.
name: App crashes or freezes on launch

description: Customers say Google Assistant reports playing their Spotify playlist but no songs play.
name: Google Assistant playback failure

description: Customers find music keeps stopping partway through songs and does not resume where it left off.
name: Playback stops midway

description: Customers feel ads play too often, between nearly every song, and are too loud, pushing them toward premium.
name: Excessive and loud ads

description: Customers lost basic player controls such as skipping, going back, repeating, or replaying a specific part of a song.
name: Player controls removed or limited

description: Customers are frustrated that songs from a playlist play in random order rather than as they expect.
name: Playlist plays songs randomly

description: Customers cannot play chosen songs, queue tracks, or skip freely, and are forced through shuffled playlists.
name: Cannot choose or queue songs

description: Customers dislike the new homescreen design and automatically playing audio elements that cannot be turned off.
name: Disliked homescreen redesign and autoplay
